description: Answers a plain-language question about Managed Nerds, or a "my X isn't working" problem, using only our own pages. It returns a written answer, where search_site returns links, list_services our services and list_guides our guides. Returns outcome (answered or no_answer), answer, sources, and for fix posts still_stuck, which says how a person can help; no_answer adds try_instead. Never gives prices. 100 answers a day across all agents; past that, 429 with Retry-After.
